role: Write path for spatial relationships in the Co-Being knowledge graph, implementing reified SpatialObservation nodes with supersession semantics.
detail: Implements spatial relationship storage via intermediate SpatialObservation Instance nodes connected by SPATIAL_SUBJECT and SPATIAL_OBJECT edges. Key classes: SpatialResult (dataclass capturing spatial_node_id, subject_edge_id, object_edge_id, superseded_node_id). Core functions: add_spatial_relationship() creates new spatial relationships with automatic supersession of prior ACTIVE nodes of same type/subject/object; supersede_spatial_relationship() marks old nodes SUPERSEDED and sets valid_to timestamp. All relationships carry INFERENCE provenance (D-TS-04: computed from sensor data, not raw sensor). Denormalization stores subject_id and object_id directly on spatial node properties to enable fast lookup without edge traversal. No transaction support in Phase 1 (deferred to Neo4j at infrastructure layer).
gotchas: Phase 1 in-memory backend has no transaction support; crash between sequential writes would leave partial state (acceptable for Phase 1, transaction support deferred to Neo4j). _find_active_spatial_node() is O(n) over spatial nodes via query then iteration, acceptable for expected Phase 1 graph size. Denormalization of subject_id/object_id on properties is deliberate trade-off for lookup efficiency.
